environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on Ubuntu 22.04 EC2 instance. Application runs as 'appuser' with standard DAC permissions. SQLite database at /var/lib/app/data.db is owned by appuser. No mandatory access control policies enforced (AppArmor in complain mode only). Application is directly exposed via port 3000 with no reverse proxy or WAF. The ATTACH DATABASE SQLite command can write arbitrary files to any path writable by appuser.
